web-guide-idea-84.audience: Dance beginners wanting an enjoyable guided routine.
web-guide-idea-84.offer: Teach a short routine at a stated level using music you may use. The value is instruction, repetition and feedback.
web-guide-idea-84.steps.1: Teach the routine in small sections.
web-guide-idea-84.steps.2: Combine the sections and offer suitable easier options.
web-guide-idea-84.equipment: A phone placed far enough away to show movement, clear floor space and suitable sound.
web-guide-idea-84.returnReason: Introduce a new routine or build on a learned movement pattern.
web-guide-idea-84.promotion: Share an authorised demonstration and specify pace and level.
web-guide-idea-84.metadataTitle: Bollywood Dance Workshop — Creator Idea & Practical Guide · Saathum
web-guide-idea-84.metadataDescription: Teach a dance routine with an instructor and music you have permission to use. Learn what to offer, how to start and what equipment you need.
